text: The help center doesn't say you have to empty your Savings before canceling Genius. Products that don't require a subscription stay available after you cancel, but I can't tell from the plan table which tier Savings (basic) or Savings (HYSA) falls under. To be safe, you may want to withdraw your funds first: go to Profile, tap "Transfer money," and choose Savings as the "from" account. Only settled funds can be withdrawn. If you're in a savings bonus offer (like the LA Sparks or Dallas Wings offers), canceling your subscription before the bonus unlocks will forfeit it.
